update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.27 - Assistant analytics suite + race-name OCR fix
Added ----- - Skill activation predictor: estimates which owned skills are likely to fire, now surfaced directly on the Skills page. - Skill ROI shopping-list planner: builds a skill purchase list that maximizes value within an SP budget. - Support deck synergy scorer: rates how well a support-card deck works together. - Post-run point-leak analyzer: pinpoints where rating was lost across a completed run. - Champions Meeting win-probability preview and post-run result correlator. - Adaptive race win-rate learning: race picks improve over time from observed results. - Sprint Speed Parent bootstrap goal preset. - Grand Live scenario scaffolding (early support), with the Speed stat cap raised to 1600.
Fixed ----- - The race-name OCR crop no longer overruns the screen's right edge. On the race selection screen the crop ran ~69px past the 1080px edge on every read and was clamped each time, spamming a "Crop region ... clamped" warning. The declared width now lands exactly on the edge, capturing the same on-screen pixels with no change to detected names and no more warning noise.
